start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:keep-customers-steps-and-targets with store {\"where\": \"postgresql database example_me on my own computer\", \"language\": \"SQL (PostgreSQL)\", \"credential_name\": \"example-me-postgres-connection\"} and records [{\"kind\": \"contact\", \"contact_id\": \"c1\", \"display_name\": \"Ada\"}]."
no_lists_because: It names no list: the customers, their steps and the product targets are kept in the person's own store, in whatever form that store keeps things, and store says where and in which language.
instructions: 1. Keep the store's login in your vault under a name you choose, and say where the store is and how it is spoken to.
2. Say "Run workflow:keep-customers-steps-and-targets" with store, and the contacts, targets and steps to keep.
3. The first run makes the store's own objects once and proves them on the example attempts; every attempt must be kept, repeated or refused as the intent says, or the run stops and says which.
4. Every later run keeps the new records and reads each product's progress and each customer's steps back.

worked_examples.title: A customer added, then a purchase kept
worked_examples.ask: Add Ada as a customer, and note that she bought the plan.

store.where: postgresql database example_me on my own computer
